text: I do not give trade instructions or size positions; the decision stays with Bernardo, and any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units. What the pack shows: on release day WTI has moved about -0.3481% per 1 sd crude-stock surprise since 2001 (t -5.7945), which is contemporaneous and predicts nothing about the coming surprise. US crude ex SPR stocks were -3.7% vs the 5-year average in the week to 2026-10-16, and the next WPSR is on 2026-10-28.
